label: heudiconv
description: Convert DICOMs using heudiconv with a built-in or custom Python heuristic.

external.installHint: pip install heudiconv. Also requires dcm2niix on PATH.

fields.label: Heuristic
fields.help: Built-in name (reproin, convertall, …) or absolute path to a .py file.

fields.label: Subject ID
fields.help: Letters and digits only. Empty = derive from PatientID.

fields.label: Session
fields.help: Letters and digits only. Empty = derive from ProtocolName.
